[Comment from Sourceforge Task]
Comment Submitter: cwilper
As per the dev discussion today, this branch is being repurposed to make the default content model assertion IMPLICIT.
This task now also includes the following:
Make the demo objects all based on FOXML (Convert to other formats at compile/test time – see Eddie's utility)
Make all the demo objects NOT assert default content model, except for a new, small set of them, which is a copy of some that already exist.
Test the behavior of the implicit vs. the explicit objects from above – should be the same.
[Comment from Sourceforge Task]
Comment Submitter: cwilper
Here's the latest word on what this branch includes (text to use for merge message)
Changes related to implicit "basic" content models:
made triple generation work correctly with the implicit hasModel relationships.
removed explicit assertion of hasModel FedoraObject-3.0 from all demo
objects, (except for a new object, demo:SmileyGreetingCard, and from
all test objects except demo:777 and demo:888) and updated
existing test expected datastream counts accordingly.
wrote tests that look for implicit and explicit "basic" content model
Additional miscellaneous cleanups
fixed html view of object profile to show multiple cmodels
got rid of dependence of GraphElementFactory – now consistently using
new SimpleURIReference/Literal/Triple classes in fedora.common.rdf package.

was correct, was not part of any test suites, and didn't work anyway
due to CMA changes.

cleaned up misc old code that assumes existence of fType

added note to readme about testing with atom

dotfiles/dirs (hidden stuff, like that under .svn/, or .cvsignore)
